title: 伪造的历史
prompt: Leaked production footage from a secret soundstage, 1969. Neil Armstrong is walking on the "Moon surface," but the camera pulls back to reveal it is just a sandbox in a studio. A boom mic operator is visible in the top corner. Stanley Kubrick is shouting instructions through a megaphone. Studio lights, film grain, slightly blurry, handheld camera movement style.
description: 借助 Nano Banana Pro，将历史虚构与未来设计融合，打造超现实创意内容，适合故事创作、数字艺术及创新营销，使用鲜明色彩增强复古科技美学。
